private Convex closeConvex(Map<Pair, BigInteger> explicit) {
    if (explicit.isEmpty()) return new Convex(Map.of());
    Set<String> names = new HashSet<>();
    for (Pair p : explicit.keySet()) {
        names.add(p.target());
        names.add(p.source());
    }
    List<String> vars = new ArrayList<>(names);
    Collections.sort(vars);
    Map<String, Integer> idx = new HashMap<>();
    for (int i = 0; i < vars.size(); i++) idx.put(vars.get(i), i);
    int n = vars.size();
    BigInteger[][] dist = new BigInteger[n][n];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) dist[i][i] = BigInteger.ZERO;
    for (Map.Entry<Pair, BigInteger> e : explicit.entrySet()) {
        Pair p = e.getKey();
        BigInteger c = e.getValue();
        if (p.target().equals(p.source())) {
            if (c.signum() < 0) return null;
            continue;
        }
        int from = idx.get(p.source());
        int to = idx.get(p.target());
        if (dist[from][to] == null || c.compareTo(dist[from][to]) < 0) dist[from][to] = c;
    }
    for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (dist[i][k] == null) continue;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (dist[k][j] == null) continue;
                BigInteger sum = dist[i][k].add(dist[k][j]);
                if (dist[i][j] == null || sum.compareTo(dist[i][j]) < 0) {
                    dist[i][j] = sum;
                    if (i == j && sum.signum() < 0) return null;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (dist[i][i] != null && dist[i][i].signum() < 0) return null;
    }
    Map<Pair, BigInteger> closed = new HashMap<>();
    for (int from = 0; from < n; from++) {
        for (int to = 0; to < n; to++) {
            if (from == to) continue;
            BigInteger c = dist[from][to];
            if (c == null) continue;
            closed.put(new Pair(vars.get(to), vars.get(from)), c);
        }
    }
    if (closed.isEmpty()) return new Convex(Map.of());
    return new Convex(Map.copyOf(closed));
}
